item.title: The role of justice partners in achieving public health goals
item.content:encoded:
This call invites research exploring how justice partners contribute to and support the achievement of public health objectives. The special issue seeks submissions that examine the intersection of justice systems and public health initiatives.

Appel publié par Public Health. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.

  • Public health goals
